1.title: Exam Orientation and How to Study
1.text: Welcome to Module zero: Exam Orientation and How to Study. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do six things. The exam at a glance. The six sections. What is new in the exam guide launched in August twenty twenty-six. How to answer every question. A study plan. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: Exam overview, section map and answer technique (all sections). Exam format: ninety minutes and fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Validated against: the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide.

1.title: The exam at a glance
1.text: The exam at a glance. Exam. Google Cloud Digital Leader (a foundational, business-level exam). Time. ninety minutes. Questions. fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Languages. English, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French. Delivery. Online-proctored or onsite-proctored. Validity. Three years. Prerequisites. None; experience collaborating with technical professionals is recommended. Renewal. A shorter renewal exam (forty-five minutes, twenty questions) is available from one hundred eighty days before expiry. The passing score is not published, so this course does not quote one. Prices change, so check the official page before you book. Exam tip: This exam is about business value, not commands. Questions describe a company with a goal and ask for the Google Cloud idea or product that fits. You never type code.

1.title: The six sections
1.text: The six sections. The figure shows this: Section map: six sections, their weights and the modules that cover them.

1.title: The six sections, continued
1.text: The six sections. one. Digital transformation with Google Cloud. Weight: about eighteen percent. Topics: Why the cloud, cloud concepts, service models, shared responsibility. two. Exploring data transformation. Weight: about eighteen percent. Topics: Value of data, data products, analytics and streaming. three. Innovating with Google Cloud A I. Weight: about eighteen percent. Topics: A I, M L, generative A I and agentic A I, Google Cloud A I solutions. four. Modernize infrastructure and applications. Weight: about eighteen percent. Topics: Migration, compute, containers, serverless, A P Is, hybrid.

1.title: The six sections, continued
1.text: The six sections. five. Trust and security with Google Cloud. Weight: about eighteen percent. Topics: Security concepts, Google's security products, trust and compliance. six. Scaling with Google Cloud operations. Weight: about ten percent. Topics: Costs, observability, reliability, S R E (site reliability engineering). Exam tip: Five sections carry about eighteen percent each; operations carries ten percent. Do not skip a section: no section is small.

1.title: What is new in the exam guide launched in August 2026
1.text: What is new in the exam guide launched in August twenty twenty-six. The exam guide launched on August twelve, twenty twenty-six replaced the older guide. The older web page for the guide still shows the older weights; follow the P D F guide. A I. Generative A I and agentic A I; Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, A I Hypercomputer, pre-built A I agents. Data. Alloy D B, Autoclass for Cloud Storage, Managed Service for Apache Spark, data supply chain, openness and interoperability. Modernization. Spot V Ms, Cloud Run functions, G K E Enterprise, Alloy D B Omni and Big Query Omni for multicloud.

1.title: What is new in the exam guide launched in August 2026, continued
1.text: What is new in the exam guide launched in August twenty twenty-six. Security. Google Threat Intelligence, Security Command Center, Google Security Operations, A I Protection, Model Armor, security of every layer of the A I stack. Operations. Observability suite, S L Is and S L Os, Dynamic Workload Scheduler and spot V Ms for cost control.

1.title: How to answer every question
1.text: How to answer every question. Read the last line to see what is asked: a benefit, a product, a model or a best practice. Find the business goal in the scenario (cut cost, move fast, analyze data, protect data, scale). Eliminate answers that are too technical or that do not fit the goal. Prefer managed and serverless products over do it yourself, unless the scenario needs control. Answer every question; there is no penalty stated for a wrong answer. Exam tip: When two answers fit, choose the one that is more managed, more scalable and needs the least effort to run.

1.title: A study plan
1.text: A study plan. one. Modules: one to two. Goal: Cloud concepts and Google Cloud basics. two. Modules: three to five. Goal: Data and analytics. three. Modules: six to seven. Goal: A I, generative A I and agents. four. Modules: eight to nine. Goal: Migration, compute, containers, serverless, A P Is. five. Modules: ten to eleven. Goal: Security and trust. six. Modules: twelve to thirteen. Goal: Costs, operations and reliability. seven. Modules: fourteen. Goal: Exam technique and final review.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A candidate asks how many questions the Cloud Digital Leader exam has. Which statement is correct? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions in ninety minutes. The exam has fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions and lasts ninety minutes.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A candidate finds an exam guide web page with different section weights than the P D F guide. Which should the candidate follow? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: The P D F guide launched in August twenty twenty-six. The P D F guide launched on August twelve, twenty twenty-six is the current one; the older page shows earlier weights.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which section of the exam has the smallest weight? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Scaling with Google Cloud operations, about ten percent. Scaling with Google Cloud operations is about ten percent; the other five are about eighteen percent each.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A question describes a retailer that wants to analyze sales data without managing servers. What is the best approach to the question? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Pick the answer that is managed and serverless for analytics. Business-level questions favor managed, serverless products that meet the stated goal with the least effort.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. After three years a credential holder wants to renew with a shorter exam. When can the renewal exam be taken? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Starting one hundred eighty days before the expiration date. The renewal exam is available starting one hundred eighty days before the credential expires.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which topic is a new emphasis of the August twenty twenty-six exam guide? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Agentic A I and generative A I. The twenty twenty-six guide adds generative A I and agentic A I to the A I section.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is the exam? Answer: ninety minutes. Question two. How many sections does the guide have? Answer: Six. Question three. Which section has about ten percent? Answer: Scaling with Google Cloud operations.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. How long is the credential valid? Answer: Three years. Question five. How long is the renewal exam? Answer: forty-five minutes with twenty questions. Question six. Is the passing score published? Answer: No.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Format: ninety minutes, fifty to sixty multiple choice, valid three years. Weights: five sections about eighteen percent, operations about ten percent. Guide: the P D F launched in August twenty twenty-six; the older web page is out of date. New: generative and agentic A I, Agent Platform, A I Hypercomputer, security for the A I stack. Method: business goal first, eliminate, choose the managed and scalable answer.
